messages:
nina: hitting a flaky issue in the streaming sampleapp when reconnects hit a 429 + Retry-After from our proxy. The client sometimes stalls and never emits the final event. Seen on node SDK 1.0.0 and python SDK 0.7.0. Anyone else?

omar: can you attach a tiny repro / nginx config? also which sampleapp branch?

nina: branch=main. repro: kick off a long stream, then on reconnect the proxy returns 429 with Retry-After: 1. Client reconnects with Last-Event-Id but output stops. Paste from logs: 
```
[INFO] reconnecting lastEventId=msg_891
[WARN] upstream responded 429 Retry-After=1
[INFO] connection established
DEBUG recv: \"data: {\\\"id\\\":\\\"msg_892\\\", \\\\"chunk\\\\\\\":\\\"Wo\"\nDEBUG recv: \"rld\\n\\n\"\nERROR parser: unexpected EOF waiting for event terminator
```

lee: sounds like two failure modes: 1) headers dropped during token refresh so Last-Event-Id isn't sent, 2) partial \"data:\" fragments split across connections and not carried over. Also saw cases where proxy buffers a pending TCP segment and sends it after the new connection is established which can reorder chunks.

omar: agreed. quick mitigations: keep a small per-connection buffer for trailing partial lines and pre-pend it on reconnect; make parser tolerant to seeing a full event across connection boundary; add a lightweight incremental seq field in payload to detect reorders/duplicates server-side.

nina: i can reproduce locally with this nginx snippet (returns 429 for reconnect paths) and a client harness. i'll add to flaky CI.

lee: SDK fixes: node SDK should preserve Last-Event-Id across auth refresh and reuse headers; python had a bug in auth refresh path that rebuilt headers and lost it. i'll open PRs: 1) preserve headers across refresh 2) parser change to buffer until \"\\n\\n\" and carry partial across retry.

omar: i'll add server-side sanity: include seq and monotonic id in every event payload so clients can detect reorder without relying on headers. Also, log when seq gap > 1.

ci-bot: created issue #1604 \"sse: reconnect 429 -> parser stall / reorder\" and attached nginx.conf + client repro.

nina: action items: nina -> add flaky-proxy CI job; lee -> PR header-preserve + parser buffering; omar -> add seqs on server and small monitor. target: ship infra fixes next week.

omar: thanks. once we have PRs we should run staging sampleapp canary for 24h and check event continuity metrics.
